items.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.summary: A new paper explores the capabilities of GPT-6-Astra, raising questions about its potential to demonstrate embodied intelligence and interact with the physical world.

items.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Researchers introduce 'Pack Light, CarryOn,' a new method for building object-oriented context that significantly enhances the performance of long-horizon AI agents.

items.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
items.summary: Anthropic has announced it will allocate 5% of its company shares to a public benefit fund, signaling a commitment to ethical AI development and societal impact.

items.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
items.summary: Disney has reached an agreement to hire most of Character.AI's employees, indicating a strategic move to bolster its AI capabilities and talent pool.

items.title: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
items.summary: A new benchmark, BizBench, highlights the practical difficulties and hidden challenges encountered when deploying long-horizon AI agents in complex real-world business scenarios.

items.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
items.summary: A new study focuses on benchmarking AI agents by evaluating their performance and capabilities when tackling complex, open-ended problems in scientific research.

items.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
items.summary: Itaú, a major financial institution, is implementing generative AI solutions to serve its entire customer base, aiming to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.

items.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
items.summary: A former Nvidia veteran, now an investor, argues that the concept of 'Physical AI' extends far beyond traditional robotics, encompassing broader interactions with the real world.

items.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen3-8B with Tinker: From 50% to 76% Accuracy, and Burning Through My Budget
items.summary: A developer shares their experience fine-tuning the Qwen3-8B model with Tinker, achieving significant accuracy improvements but also incurring substantial computational costs.

items.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
items.summary: Researchers introduce HexaShell, a lightweight framework designed to test the boundaries of Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents in their capacity as robot coding agents.

items.title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
items.summary: OpenMobile-2 presents advancements in creating adaptable mobile AI agents by leveraging scalable environments and integrating app-native tools for enhanced versatility.

items.title: Google Beam expands with new regions, partners, and customers
items.summary: Google Beam, an AI-powered service, is expanding its reach by adding new operational regions, forging new partnerships, and acquiring more customers.

items.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
items.summary: Stack Overflow for Agents has seen a threefold increase in signups, attributed to the successful integration and adoption of its ChatGPT plugin.

items.title: My AI Experiment Was Going Great Until My Client Replied 😂
items.summary: An AI experiment went awry when a client's unexpected reply exposed the limitations or humorous misinterpretations of the AI system.

items.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: A new research paper introduces Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation, a novel technique designed to improve long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning by leveraging tree-structured knowledge.
